meta.title: Small improvements to reduce allocations in validation filter logic
meta.body_summary: Replace fixed-size arrays with a lazily-initialized List of structs in ValidationEndpointFilterFactory to reduce allocations when few or no parameters require validation.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot replaced fixed-size arrays with List<struct> to reduce allocations; after style and correctness feedback from gfoidl, captainsafia, BrennanConroy, it refined code and was merged without benchmark.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 73 changed lines in a single file, this is a very small edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step, fast-turnaround performance PR where a minimal allocation optimization was accepted after several rounds of style/correctness refinement, consistent with the successful merge.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainers requested modern C# syntax (primary constructors for struct, collection expressions for list initialization) and a lazy-initialization pattern to avoid allocating the list when no validatable parameters exist.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce allocations in validation filter by replacing mandatory parameter-count-based arrays with a sparse list of struct entries, and avoid List allocation entirely for endpoints with no validatable parameters.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot delivered a correct allocation reduction but needed multiple rounds of feedback to adopt idiomatic C# patterns (primary constructors, collection expressions) and to implement a zero-allocation lazy-initialization for the no-validation path.

detection_detail.code_reading: gfoidl, captainsafia, and BrennanConroy reviewed the code and provided iterative style/optimization feedback; no profiling or benchmark evidence was used.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Maintainer acknowledged no benchmarks for validation filter; the allocation improvement was accepted based on reasoning and existing test coverage.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After initial commit, style and optimization suggestions were applied by Copilot within the same PR; final commit used collection expression syntax per captainsafia's request.

core_change_summary.description: In ValidationEndpointFilterFactory.cs, replaced mandatory IValidatableInfo[] and string[] arrays with a lazily-initialized List<ValidatableParameterEntry>; introduced a record struct ValidatableParameterEntry to bundle index, validatable info, and display name; filter delegate now iterates only validatable entries with early break when index exceeds argument count.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: All changes confined to a single file.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: replaced arrays with List<ValidatableParameterEntry> using explicit struct and full namespace.
Second commit: converted struct to record struct with primary constructor, added using directive, changed continue to break.
Third commit: made list nullable and lazy-initialized with ??= new() to skip allocation when no validatable parameters.
Fourth commit: switched to collection expression syntax ??= [] per maintainer preference.

review_signals.summary: Suggested primary constructor for struct and early break instead of continue in loop.
Requested primary constructor, using directive, and early break; later asked for collection expression syntax.
Suggested lazy-initialization with ??= new() to avoid list allocation when no validatable parameters exist.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot implemented lazy-init in third commit.

review_signals.summary: Final APPROVED review after all feedback addressed.
Noted no benchmarks exist for validation filter but considered the delta straightforward to review.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with initial array-to-list refactor; gfoidl posted three style suggestions within ~9 hours.
captainsafia relayed gfoidl's comments under her review to trigger agent (limitation: Copilot only responds to initiator).
Copilot applied primary constructor, using fix, and break change in a second commit.
BrennanConroy suggested lazy-initialization to avoid list allocation; Copilot implemented with ??= new().
After further discussion on syntax, captainsafia requested collection expression ??= []; Copilot applied final commit.
BrennanConroy approved; PR merged after ~6 days.
